title: EspressoLab recipe
description: Brew inputs in dashboard units. The solver converts to SI at load time (section 4.2).
$comment: Audit P6, issue #19: kept synchronized with engine/artifact_io/json_io.cpp's load_recipe_json() (structure and required-ness) and engine/espresso_core/types.cpp's Recipe::validate() (ranges and the profile/parallel_regions cross-field rules noted below, which load_recipe_json() itself does not check and this schema cannot express structurally) -- see CLAUDE.md 'Data contracts'.

schema_version.description: Optional: load_recipe_json() defaults an absent schema_version to the current version, so it is not in the required list above. A present value must still be exactly "1.0".

puck.$comment: Grind is spelled either as the scalar pair (particle_diameter_um + particle_spread_factor) or as a distribution (grind), never both -- load_recipe_json() rejects a document carrying both with CONFLICTING_FIELD. The oneOf below expresses that. When grind is present the loader derives the two scalars from it (d32 and the equivalent spread factor) and dump_recipe_json() emits only the distribution, so recipe_hash() is taken over the authored input rather than the derivation.

particle_diameter_um.description: Effective particle diameter, not a grinder dial setting (section 5.3).

particle_spread_factor.description: Empirical penalty for fines and a broad distribution.

grind.description: Particle size distribution, in place of the scalar pair above. The solver derives the representative diameter (Sauter mean, d32) and the spread penalty from it.

bins.$comment: Strictly increasing diameter and mass fractions summing to 1 are enforced by GrindDistribution::validate(), not this schema, which cannot express an item-to-item or cross-item constraint. The derived d32 must additionally fall in 150-800 um; Recipe::validate() enforces that.

diameter_um.description: Wider than the scalar particle_diameter_um envelope on purpose: real coffee fines sit at 10-100 um. It is the derived d32, not any single bin, that must land in 150-800 um.

pressure_profile_bar.description: Gauge pressure across the puck, 0-12 bar. Point ranges are enforced here; strictly increasing time is enforced by Recipe::validate(), not this schema (see $defs.profile_pressure).

temperature_profile_c.description: Inlet water temperature, 85-100 C. Point ranges are enforced here; strictly increasing time is enforced by Recipe::validate(), not this schema (see $defs.profile_temperature).

axial_cells.description: Fidelity level 3: stacked finite-volume cells along the flow direction, applied to every region. 1 is the lumped Level 2 puck.

parallel_regions.description: Optional lateral puck partitions that share pressure but evolve independently. Omit for one uniform region. area_fraction across all regions must also sum to 1; that cross-item constraint is enforced by Recipe::validate(), not this schema.

target_beverage_g.description: Optional mass-based stop; null runs to the time limit.

profile_pressure.$comment: Ordered [time_s, bar] points, linearly interpolated and held flat outside the range (section 5.2). Time is checked here only for non-negativity; PiecewiseLinearProfile::validate() additionally requires each point's time strictly greater than the previous one, which a JSON Schema array constraint cannot express item-to-item.

profile_temperature.$comment: Ordered [time_s, celsius] points, linearly interpolated and held flat outside the range (section 5.2). Time is checked here only for non-negativity; PiecewiseLinearProfile::validate() additionally requires each point's time strictly greater than the previous one, which a JSON Schema array constraint cannot express item-to-item.
